description: Oregon Utility-Scale Battery Storage Inventory is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Chris Robertson. Facility-level inventory of Oregon utility-scale battery energy storage at 5 MW nameplate and above: 41 facilities totalling 8,583 MW and 36,011 MWh across four development stages (operating, under construction, approved, and proposed) through the 2031 pipeline. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
